output.answer: Berkshire Hathaway's most recent 13F-HR covers the quarter ended June 30, 2026 (accession 0001193125-26-352200, filed with the SEC on August 14, 2026); as of November 11, 2026 the Q3 2026 13F had not yet been filed (filings were due November 16). The Q2 report discloses $299,253,556,246 of US-listed equity holdings across 29 issuers (89 line entries, 14 included managers), led by Apple (227,917,808 shares, $65.95bn), American Express (151,610,700 shares, $51.28bn), Coca-Cola (400,000,000 shares, $32.51bn), Alphabet (78,791,167 Class A + 27,188,433 Class C shares, $37.76bn combined), Bank of America (483,394,015 shares, $27.54bn), Chevron (84,375,856 shares, $13.99bn) and Occidental Petroleum (264,941,431 shares, $12.87bn). Versus the Q1 2026 filing, Berkshire exited Constellation Brands (632,890 shares), added roughly 48.1 million Alphabet shares and 17.5 million Delta Air Lines shares, and trimmed Bank of America (~30.2M shares), Kroger (-11M), Capital One (-4.15M), Nucor (-2.05M), Ally (-2M) and DaVita (-1.22M), while leaving Apple, Coca-Cola, American Express, Chevron, Occidental and its other core stakes unchanged. These positions are as of June 30, 2026; the 13F excludes Berkshire's wholly owned operating businesses, and values move with market prices.
caveats: 13F filings snapshot only 13F-eligible (mainly US-listed equity) holdings at quarter-end market values: they exclude Berkshire's wholly owned operating businesses, most fixed income, short positions and any confidentially treated positions, and values have moved with market prices since June 30, 2026.
The Q3 2026 13F (quarter ended September 30, 2026) had not been filed as of 2026-11-11; filings were due November 16, 2026, so current positions may differ from the June 30 snapshot.

Issuer names are spelled differently across consecutive filings (e.g. 'BANK AMERICA CORP COM' in Q1 vs 'BANK OF AMER CORP COM' in Q2; 'CHUBB LTD SWITZ COM' vs 'CHUBB LIMITED COM'); these are the same CUSIPs, and quarter-over-quarter share deltas were computed on CUSIP, not on name strings.
Berkshire has historically been granted confidential treatment for some positions while building them, so a 13F may not reveal every holding.
